name: Sentence similarity in zh-TW
description: Four pairs share meaning, not words

params.value:
今天天氣很好，我們去公園散步吧。
天氣晴朗，很適合到戶外走走。
這家餐廳的牛肉麵非常好吃。
我推薦這間店的滷肉飯，味道很棒。
股市今天大幅下跌，投資人很緊張。
台股收盤重挫，市場情緒低迷。
機器學習模型需要大量資料來訓練。
Training a neural network requires a large dataset.

data.noteContent:
Four pairs of sentences, written so that the two halves of a pair share few characters: weather, food, the stock market, and machine learning across Chinese and English. The encoder puts each pair together anyway, which is what "by meaning" means here. After a run read print_top: rank 1 is always the sentence itself at 1.0, and rank 2 should be its partner. EmbeddingScatter plots the eight vectors in 2D on its own body. Needs the sentence-embeddings pack from Package Center, about 470 MB for this encoder; the run is then offline and a few seconds on CPU.

四組句子配對，每組刻意寫成沒幾個字相同：天氣、食物、股市，最後一組是中文對英文的機器學習。編碼器還是能把每一組湊在一起，這就是這裡說的「看意思」。跑完看 print_top：第 1 名一定是句子自己、分數 1.0，第 2 名應該是它的配對句。EmbeddingScatter 節點本身會把八條向量畫成 2D 散點圖。需要套件中心的 sentence-embeddings 套件包，這個編碼器約 470 MB；裝好之後離線執行，CPU 上大約幾秒。

split_lines is on, so each of the eight lines becomes its own vector; turn it off and the whole block is embedded as one. Swap model for BAAI/bge-small-zh-v1.5 to try a Chinese-only encoder, a separate 95 MB download from the same pack.

split_lines 開著，所以八行各自變成一條向量；關掉的話整段會被當成一段文字編碼。把 model 換成 BAAI/bge-small-zh-v1.5 就能試中文專用的編碼器，那是同一個套件包裡另一項 95 MB 的下載。

queries and keys are the same eight vectors, so every row's first hit is itself at 1.0; a run where it is not means the two ports no longer carry the same tensor. top_k is 3, so the column worth reading is the second one.

queries 與 keys 是同一組八條向量，所以每一列的第 1 名都是自己、分數 1.0；要是不是，就代表兩個輸入埠已經不是同一份資料。top_k 是 3，真正要看的是第 2 名那一欄。
